questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'The chef cooks the meal.'

options.option_text: The meal is cooked by the chef.
The meal was cooked by the chef.
The meal is being cooked by the chef.
The meal cooked by the chef.

questions.explanation: Present simple passive = is + past participle.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'They will complete the project.'

options.option_text: The project is completed by them.
The project will completed by them.
The project will be completed by them.
The project would be completed by them.

questions.explanation: Future passive = will be + past participle.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'She is singing a song.'

options.option_text: A song is sung by her.
A song is being sung by her.
A song was being sung by her.
A song has been sung by her.

questions.explanation: Present continuous passive = is being + past participle.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'The dog bit the man.'

options.option_text: The man is bitten by the dog.
The man was bitten by the dog.
The man was bit by the dog.
The man has been bitten by the dog.

questions.explanation: Past simple passive = was + past participle.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'People speak English all over the world.'

options.option_text: English was spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
English has spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.

questions.explanation: The vague agent 'people' is dropped in the passive.

questions.stem: Change to active voice: 'The letter was posted by him.'

options.option_text: He posts the letter.
He posted the letter.
He has posted the letter.
He had posted the letter.

questions.explanation: Past simple passive becomes past simple active.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'The teacher is explaining the lesson.'

options.option_text: The lesson is being explained by the teacher.
The lesson is explained by the teacher.
The lesson was being explained by the teacher.
The lesson has been explained by the teacher.

questions.explanation: Present continuous passive = is being + past participle.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'Close the window.'

options.option_text: The window is closed.
Let the window be closed.
The window was closed.
Let the window close.

questions.explanation: Imperative passive = 'Let + object + be + past participle'.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'Who broke the vase?'

options.option_text: Who was the vase broken?
By whom the vase was broken?
Whom broke the vase?
By whom was the vase broken?

questions.explanation: Interrogative passive with 'who' = 'By whom + was + object + V3'.

questions.stem: Change to passive voice: 'The workers have built the bridge.'

options.option_text: The bridge is built by the workers.
The bridge was built by the workers.
The bridge had been built by the workers.
The bridge has been built by the workers.

questions.explanation: Present perfect passive = has/have been + past participle.
